ko.title: 사상 최고치의 나스닥, 좁아진 시장: 월스트리트를 지탱하는 종목이 줄어든 이유

segments.src: The headline looks great: the Nasdaq 100 is back at record highs.
segments.tr: 헤드라인은 멋져 보입니다. 나스닥 100 지수가 다시 사상 최고치를 기록했습니다.

segments.src: Look underneath it, though, and the picture is more mixed.
segments.tr: 하지만 그 이면을 살펴보면 양상은 더욱 혼조세를 보입니다.

segments.src: A small group of technology and artificial intelligence mega-caps is doing much of the lifting.
segments.tr: 소수의 기술 및 인공지능(AI) 대형주들이 상승의 대부분을 견인하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Meanwhile, well-known consumer and housing-related companies such as Lennar, Lowe's and McDonald's have been trading near their 52-week lows, and Treasury yields have been climbing.
segments.tr: 반면 레나(Lennar), 로우스(Lowe's), 맥도날드(McDonald's) 같은 유명 소비재 및 주택 관련 기업들은 52주 신저가 근처에서 거래되고 있으며, 국채 금리는 상승세를 이어왔습니다.

segments.src: This pattern is often called **narrow market breadth**.
segments.tr: 이러한 패턴은 흔히 **좁은 시장 폭(narrow market breadth)**이라고 불립니다.

segments.src: This article explains what it means, why it matters for ordinary savers, and what to watch as earnings season begins.
segments.tr: 이 글에서는 이것이 무엇을 의미하는지, 일반 투자자들에게 왜 중요한지, 그리고 실적 시즌이 시작됨에 따라 무엇을 주시해야 하는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *이 글은 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 합니다.

segments.src: It is not investment advice, and it does not recommend buying or selling any security.*
segments.tr: 투자 조언이 아니며, 어떠한 유가증권의 매수나 매도를 추천하지 않습니다.*

segments.src: ## What "market breadth" actually measures
segments.tr: ## "시장 폭"이 실제로 측정하는 것

segments.src: Breadth describes how many stocks take part in a market move.
segments.tr: 시장 폭은 얼마나 많은 종목이 시장의 움직임에 동참하는지를 나타냅니다.

segments.src: In a broad rally, most sectors and a large share of individual stocks rise together.
segments.tr: 광범위한 상승장에서는 대부분의 섹터와 상당수의 개별 종목이 함께 상승합니다.

segments.src: In a narrow rally, the index climbs because a handful of very large companies are rising, while many others stall or fall.
segments.tr: 반면 제한적인 상승장에서는 소수의 초대형 기업들이 상승하는 반면 다른 많은 종목들은 정체되거나 하락하기 때문에 지수가 상승하게 됩니다.

segments.src: Analysts usually look at a few simple gauges:
segments.tr: 분석가들은 대개 몇 가지 간단한 지표를 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: - **Advancers versus decliners:** how many stocks rose compared with how many fell on a given day or week.
segments.tr: - **상승 종목 대 하락 종목:** 특정 일주일 또는 하루 동안 하락한 종목에 비해 얼마나 많은 종목이 상승했는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: - **Stocks near highs versus lows:** how many index members sit close to 52-week highs compared with 52-week lows.
segments.tr: - **신고가 근접 종목 대 신저가 근접 종목:** 지수 구성 종목 중 52주 신고가 근처에 있는 종목이 52주 신저가 근처에 있는 종목과 비교하여 얼마나 되는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: - **Equal-weight versus cap-weight performance:** whether the average stock is keeping pace with the market-cap-weighted index.
segments.tr: - **동일 가중 대 시가총액 가중 성과:** 평균적인 주식이 시가총액 가중 지수와 발을 맞추고 있는지 여부를 나타냅니다.

segments.src: - **Share of stocks above their 200-day moving average:** a rough read on the health of the typical stock.
segments.tr: - **200일 이동평균선 상회 종목 비율:** 전형적인 주식의 건강 상태를 대략적으로 파악할 수 있는 지표입니다.

segments.src: When the headline index sets records while these gauges weaken, it is a sign that gains are concentrated.
segments.tr: 헤드라인 지수가 기록을 경신하는 동안 이러한 지표들이 약화된다면, 이는 상승세가 집중되어 있다는 신호입니다.

segments.src: ## Why a few giants can move the whole index
segments.tr: ## 소수의 거대 기업이 전체 지수를 움직일 수 있는 이유

segments.src: Most major U.S.
segments.tr: 나스닥 100과 S&P 500을 포함한 대부분의 주요 미국

segments.src: indexes, including the Nasdaq 100 and the S&P 500, are **market-cap weighted**.
segments.tr: 지수는 **시가총액 가중 방식**으로 산출됩니다.

segments.src: The bigger a company's market value, the more influence it has on the index.
segments.tr: 기업의 시장 가치가 클수록 지수에 미치는 영향력도 커집니다.

segments.src: A few of the largest technology and AI-linked companies can therefore account for a very large share of an index's daily moves.
segments.tr: 따라서 가장 규모가 큰 몇몇 기술 및 AI 관련 기업들이 지수의 일일 변동에서 매우 큰 비중을 차지할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If those companies rally on enthusiasm for AI spending, cloud demand or strong profit forecasts, the index can rise even when most other members are flat or falling.
segments.tr: AI 지출, 클라우드 수요, 강력한 실적 전망에 대한 기대감으로 이들 기업이 상승세를 타면, 다른 대부분의 구성 종목들이 보합세를 보이거나 하락할 때도 지수는 상승할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The reverse also applies: a setback in a few leaders can pull the whole index lower, even when the rest of the market is steady.
segments.tr: 그 반대의 경우도 마찬가지입니다. 소수의 주도주가 부진을 겪으면 나머지 시장이 안정세를 보일 때도 전체 지수를 끌어내릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The other side of the picture: pressure on rate-sensitive and consumer names
segments.tr: ## 이면의 다른 모습: 금리 민감주와 소비재 종목들이 받는 압박

segments.src: Rising Treasury yields help explain why some parts of the market are lagging.
segments.tr: 미 국채 금리 상승은 시장의 일부 부문이 뒤처지는 이유를 설명하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: Higher yields tend to affect companies in several ways:
segments.tr: 금리 상승은 여러 방식으로 기업에 영향을 미치는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Housing and homebuilding:** Mortgage rates tend to follow longer-term yields. Higher borrowing costs can weigh on home purchases and on homebuilders such as Lennar.
segments.tr: - **주택 및 주택 건설:** 모기지 금리는 장기 국채 금리를 따르는 경향이 있습니다. 차입 비용이 높아지면 주택 구입과 레나 같은 주택 건설업체에 부담을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Home improvement:** Retailers like Lowe's can be sensitive to housing turnover and big-ticket renovation spending, both of which cool when financing becomes more expensive.
segments.tr: - **주택 개조:** 로우스 같은 소매업체들은 주택 거래 회전율과 고가의 리노베이션 지출에 민감할 수 있으며, 자금 조달 비용이 비싸지면 이 두 가지 모두 둔화됩니다.

segments.src: - **Consumer spending:** Restaurant and food chains such as McDonald's depend on steady traffic. If households feel squeezed by higher prices or borrowing costs, they may trade down or visit less often.
segments.tr: - **소비자 지출:** 맥도날드 같은 레스토랑 및 식품 체인은 꾸준한 방문객 유입에 의존합니다. 가계가 고물가나 높은 차입 비용으로 압박을 느끼면 소비를 줄이거나 방문 횟수를 줄일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Valuation math:** When "risk-free" Treasury yields rise, future profits are discounted more heavily, and stocks without fast growth can look less attractive by comparison.
segments.tr: - **밸류에이션 산정:** '무위험' 국채 금리가 상승하면 미래의 이익이 더 크게 할인되며, 빠른 성장이 없는 주식은 상대적으로 덜 매력적으로 보일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Each company has its own story, and a low share price alone does not tell you whether a business is struggling or simply out of favor.
segments.tr: 각 기업마다 고유한 사정이 있으며, 낮은 주가만으로는 해당 기업이 어려움을 겪고 있는지 단순히 인기를 잃었는지 알 수 없습니다.

segments.src: The broader point is that several familiar names are not participating in the index's strength.
segments.tr: 더 큰 핵심은 우리에게 익숙한 여러 기업들이 지수의 강세에 동참하지 못하고 있다는 점입니다.

segments.src: ## What this means for retirement accounts and index-fund investors
segments.tr: ## 이것이 은퇴 계좌와 인덱스 펀드 투자자에게 의미하는 바

segments.src: Many people own the market through 401(k) plans, IRAs and low-cost index funds.
segments.tr: 많은 사람들이 401(k) 플랜, IRA, 저비용 인덱스 펀드를 통해 시장을 보유하고 있습니다.

segments.src: That is a sensible, diversified approach for many investors, but it is worth understanding what you actually hold.
segments.tr: 이는 많은 투자자들에게 합리적이고 분산된 접근 방식이지만, 자신이 실제로 무엇을 보유하고 있는지 이해할 필요가 있습니다.

segments.src: Index funds can be more concentrated than they look.**
segments.tr: 인덱스 펀드는 생각보다 더 집중되어 있을 수 있습니다.**

segments.src: A fund that tracks a cap-weighted index may put a large share of its assets in a small number of companies.
segments.tr: 시가총액 가중 지수를 추종하는 펀드는 자산의 상당 부분을 소수의 기업에 집중시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If you also hold a target-date fund, a large-cap growth fund and a Nasdaq 100 fund, your overlap in the same mega-caps may be bigger than you expect.
segments.tr: 목표일 펀드, 대형주 성장 펀드, 나스닥 100 펀드를 함께 보유하고 있다면 동일한 대형 기술주와 겹치는 부분이 예상보다 클 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Concentration cuts both ways.**
segments.tr: 집중 투자는 양날의 검입니다.**

segments.src: When leaders keep rising, cap-weighted funds benefit.
segments.tr: 주도주가 계속 상승할 때 시가총액 가중 펀드는 수혜를 입습니다.

segments.src: If leadership fades, those funds can feel it more than an equal-weighted or broadly diversified portfolio would.
segments.tr: 하지만 주도력이 약화되면 이러한 펀드들은 동일 가중치나 광범위하게 분산된 포트폴리오보다 그 타격을 더 크게 느낄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A record high is not a prediction.**
segments.tr: 사상 최고치가 미래를 예측하는 것은 아닙니다.**

segments.src: Narrow markets can last longer than skeptics expect, and breadth can also improve without any sharp decline.
segments.tr: 좁은 시장은 회의론자들의 예상보다 오래 지속될 수 있으며, 급격한 하락 없이도 시장 폭은 개선될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Weak breadth is a caution flag about the quality of a rally, not a timing signal.
segments.tr: 약한 시장 폭은 상승장의 질에 대한 경고 신호이지 타이밍 신호가 아닙니다.

segments.src: Time horizon matters.**
segments.tr: 투자 기간이 중요합니다.**

segments.src: Someone decades from retirement faces different risks than someone planning to withdraw funds within a few years.
segments.tr: 은퇴를 수십 년 앞둔 사람은 몇 년 안에 자금을 인출할 계획인 사람과 다른 위험에 직면하게 됩니다.

segments.src: Those closer to retirement may want to check whether their allocation still matches their tolerance for a drawdown.
segments.tr: 은퇴에 가까워진 사람들은 자신의 자산 배분이 하락 위험에 대한 감내 수준과 여전히 일치하는지 점검해 볼 필요가 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Practical steps worth considering
segments.tr: ## 고려해 볼 만한 실천적 단계

segments.src: These are general habits, not personalized advice:
segments.tr: 이는 맞춤형 조언이 아니라 일반적인 습관입니다.

segments.src: - **Check your fund holdings.** Most providers list a fund's top ten holdings and sector weights. Add them up across your accounts to see your real exposure.
segments.tr: - **펀드 보유 종목을 확인하세요.** 대부분의 운용사는 펀드의 상위 10개 보유 종목과 섹터 비중을 공개합니다. 계좌 전체에 걸쳐 이를 합산하여 실제 노출도를 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Review overlap.** Several funds with different names can own much of the same stocks.
segments.tr: - **중복 투자 여부를 검토하세요.** 이름이 다른 여러 펀드들이 대개 동일한 주식을 많이 보유하고 있을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Rebalance on a schedule.** If strong gains in one area have pushed your portfolio away from your target mix, rebalancing returns it to the level of risk you chose.
segments.tr: - **일정에 따라 리밸런싱하세요.** 특정 영역의 강한 상승으로 인해 포트폴리오가 목표 혼합 비율에서 벗어났다면, 리밸런싱을 통해 자신이 선택한 위험 수준으로 되돌릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Keep emergency savings separate.** Money you may need soon generally should not depend on stock market levels.
segments.tr: - **비상자금은 따로 분리해 두세요.** 조만간 필요할 수 있는 돈은 일반적으로 주식 시장 수준에 의존해서는 안 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Staying consistent with a long-term plan often matters more than responding to each record or pullback.
segments.tr: - **헤드라인에 일희일비하지 마세요.** 장기적인 계획을 꾸준히 유지하는 것이 매번 기록 경신이나 조정에 반응하는 것보다 대개 더 중요합니다.

segments.src: - **Consider speaking with a licensed financial professional** about your own goals, taxes and timeline.
segments.tr: - **자신의 목표, 세금, 투자 기간에 대해 면허를 소지한 금융 전문가와 상담하는 것을 고려해 보세요.**

segments.src: ## What to watch as earnings season begins
segments.tr: ## 실적 시즌이 시작될 때 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: Quarterly reports give investors fresh evidence on whether the narrow leadership is justified and whether the laggards are stabilizing.
segments.tr: 분기별 실적 보고서는 투자자들에게 편중된 주도세가 정당한지, 그리고 부진한 종목들이 안정세를 찾아가고 있는지에 대한 새로운 증거를 제공합니다.

segments.src: Useful things to look for include:
segments.tr: 살펴봐야 할 유용한 사항은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: - **Mega-cap guidance:** Do technology and AI leaders show that spending and demand are translating into earnings growth?
segments.tr: - **대형주 가이던스:** 기술 및 AI 주도 기업들의 지출과 수요가 실제 이익 성장으로 이어지고 있음을 보여주는가?

segments.src: - **Capital spending plans:** Large AI-related investment can support suppliers and cloud providers, but investors will watch for returns on that spending.
segments.tr: - **설비 투자 계획:** 대규모 AI 관련 투자는 공급업체와 클라우드 제공업체를 지원할 수 있지만, 투자자들은 해당 지출에 대한 투자 수익(ROI)을 주시할 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Housing-related commentary:** Homebuilders and home-improvement retailers may discuss orders, pricing, incentives and the effect of mortgage rates.
segments.tr: - **주택 관련 코멘트:** 주택 건설업체 및 주택 개조 소매업체들은 주문, 가격 책정, 인센티브, 모기지 금리의 영향 등에 대해 논의할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Consumer trends:** Restaurant and retail results can show how households are responding to prices and borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **소비자 트렌드:** 레스토랑 및 소매업 실적은 가계가 가격과 차입 비용에 어떻게 대응하고 있는지 보여줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Treasury yields:** Continued moves in yields can shift how investors value both growth and defensive stocks.
segments.tr: - **국채 금리:** 금리의 지속적인 움직임은 투자자들이 성장주와 방어주를 평가하는 방식을 변화시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Breadth indicators:** If more stocks begin to join the advance, that would suggest the market's foundation is widening.
segments.tr: - **시장 폭 지표:** 더 많은 종목이 상승세에 동참하기 시작한다면, 이는 시장의 기반이 넓어지고 있음을 시사하는 것입니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: A record-setting Nasdaq 100 is real, and so is the fact that a relatively small group of companies is doing a lot of the work.
segments.tr: 사상 최고치를 경신하는 나스닥 100은 현실이며, 비교적 소수의 기업들이 많은 역할을 하고 있다는 점도 사실입니다.

segments.src: For retirement savers and index-fund investors, the useful response is not alarm or excitement but awareness: know what your funds hold, understand how concentrated they may be, and make sure your portfolio still fits your goals and time horizon.

zh.title: 纳斯达克再创新高，但市场宽度收窄：为何领涨美股的股票越来越少

segments.src: The headline looks great: the Nasdaq 100 is back at record highs.
segments.tr: 头条新闻看起来很美妙：纳斯达克100指数再次重返历史新高。

segments.src: Look underneath it, though, and the picture is more mixed.
segments.tr: 然而，如果仔细观察表面之下，前景却更加喜忧参半。

segments.src: A small group of technology and artificial intelligence mega-caps is doing much of the lifting.
segments.tr: 一小部分科技和人工智能巨头承担了绝大部分涨幅。

segments.src: Meanwhile, well-known consumer and housing-related companies such as Lennar, Lowe's and McDonald's have been trading near their 52-week lows, and Treasury yields have been climbing.
segments.tr: 与此同时，如 Lennar、Lowe's 和 McDonald's 等知名消费与房地产相关企业的股价一直在52周低点附近徘徊，而美债收益率也在不断上升。

segments.src: This pattern is often called **narrow market breadth**.
segments.tr: 这种格局通常被称为**窄幅市场宽度（narrow market breadth）**。

segments.src: This article explains what it means, why it matters for ordinary savers, and what to watch as earnings season begins.
segments.tr: 本文将解释这意味着什么、为什么它对普通储蓄者很重要，以及在财报季开始之际需要关注什么。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考。

segments.src: It is not investment advice, and it does not recommend buying or selling any security.*
segments.tr: 它不构成投资建议，也不建议买卖任何证券。*

segments.src: ## What "market breadth" actually measures
segments.tr: ## 什么是“市场宽度”实际衡量的指标

segments.src: Breadth describes how many stocks take part in a market move.
segments.tr: 宽度描述了参与市场走势的股票数量。

segments.src: In a broad rally, most sectors and a large share of individual stocks rise together.
segments.tr: 在广泛的上涨行情中，大多数板块和绝大部分个股会共同上涨。

segments.src: In a narrow rally, the index climbs because a handful of very large companies are rising, while many others stall or fall.
segments.tr: 而在狭窄的上涨行情中，指数上涨是因为少数几家超级大公司在推高，而许多其他股票则停滞不前或下跌。

segments.src: Analysts usually look at a few simple gauges:
segments.tr: 分析师通常会查看几个简单的衡量指标：

segments.src: - **Advancers versus decliners:** how many stocks rose compared with how many fell on a given day or week.
segments.tr: - **上涨与下跌家数比（Advancers versus decliners）：** 在特定天数或周内，上涨股票数量与下跌股票数量的对比。

segments.src: - **Stocks near highs versus lows:** how many index members sit close to 52-week highs compared with 52-week lows.
segments.tr: - **接近高点与低点的股票数：** 接近52周高点的指数成分股数量与接近52周低点的对比。

segments.src: - **Equal-weight versus cap-weight performance:** whether the average stock is keeping pace with the market-cap-weighted index.
segments.tr: - **等权重与按市值权重表现对比：** 普通股票的平均表现是否跟上了按市值加权的指数。

segments.src: - **Share of stocks above their 200-day moving average:** a rough read on the health of the typical stock.
segments.tr: - **位于200日均线之上的股票比例：** 粗略反映典型股票健康状况的指标。

segments.src: When the headline index sets records while these gauges weaken, it is a sign that gains are concentrated.
segments.tr: 当头部指数创下新高而这些指标却走弱时，这表明涨幅高度集中。

segments.src: ## Why a few giants can move the whole index
segments.tr: ## 为什么少数巨头能拉动整个指数

segments.src: Most major U.S.
segments.tr: 大多数美国主要

segments.src: indexes, including the Nasdaq 100 and the S&P 500, are **market-cap weighted**.
segments.tr: 指数，包括纳斯达克100指数和标准普尔500指数，都是**按市值加权的**。

segments.src: The bigger a company's market value, the more influence it has on the index.
segments.tr: 一家公司的市值越大，它对指数的影响力就越大。

segments.src: A few of the largest technology and AI-linked companies can therefore account for a very large share of an index's daily moves.
segments.tr: 因此，少数几家最大的科技和AI相关公司就能占据指数每日走势的极大部分。

segments.src: If those companies rally on enthusiasm for AI spending, cloud demand or strong profit forecasts, the index can rise even when most other members are flat or falling.
segments.tr: 如果这些公司因市场对AI支出、云需求的热情或强劲的利润预期而大涨，即使大多数其他成分股平盘或下跌，指数也能上涨。

segments.src: The reverse also applies: a setback in a few leaders can pull the whole index lower, even when the rest of the market is steady.
segments.tr: 反之亦然：即使市场的其余部分表现平稳，少数领头羊的挫折也可能拉低整个指数。

segments.src: ## The other side of the picture: pressure on rate-sensitive and consumer names
segments.tr: ## 问题的另一面：利率敏感型和消费类股票承压

segments.src: Rising Treasury yields help explain why some parts of the market are lagging.
segments.tr: 美债收益率上升有助于解释为什么市场的某些部分表现落后。

segments.src: Higher yields tend to affect companies in several ways:
segments.tr: 较高的收益率往往会从以下几个方面影响公司：

segments.src: - **Housing and homebuilding:** Mortgage rates tend to follow longer-term yields. Higher borrowing costs can weigh on home purchases and on homebuilders such as Lennar.
segments.tr: - **住房与房企：** 抵押贷款利率往往跟随长期收益率。借贷成本上升可能会抑制房屋购买以及像 Lennar 这样的建筑商。

segments.src: - **Home improvement:** Retailers like Lowe's can be sensitive to housing turnover and big-ticket renovation spending, both of which cool when financing becomes more expensive.
segments.tr: - **家居装修：** 像 Lowe's 这样的零售商对住房换手率和大额装修支出非常敏感，当融资变得更加昂贵时，这两者都会降温。

segments.src: - **Consumer spending:** Restaurant and food chains such as McDonald's depend on steady traffic. If households feel squeezed by higher prices or borrowing costs, they may trade down or visit less often.
segments.tr: - **消费者支出：** 像 McDonald's 这样的连锁餐厅和食品企业依赖于稳定的客流量。如果家庭感受到高物价或高借贷成本的挤压，他们可能会降级消费或减少光顾次数。

segments.src: - **Valuation math:** When "risk-free" Treasury yields rise, future profits are discounted more heavily, and stocks without fast growth can look less attractive by comparison.
segments.tr: - **估值逻辑：** 当“无风险”的美债收益率上升时，未来利润会被更大幅度地折现，缺乏快速增长的股票相比之下吸引力就会下降。

segments.src: Each company has its own story, and a low share price alone does not tell you whether a business is struggling or simply out of favor.
segments.tr: 每家公司都有自己的故事，单纯低廉的股价并不能告诉你一家企业是在艰难挣扎还是仅仅不受青睐。

segments.src: The broader point is that several familiar names are not participating in the index's strength.
segments.tr: 更广泛的一点是，几个大家熟知的名字并没有参与到指数的强势上涨中。

segments.src: ## What this means for retirement accounts and index-fund investors
segments.tr: ## 这对养老金账户和指数基金投资者意味着什么

segments.src: Many people own the market through 401(k) plans, IRAs and low-cost index funds.
segments.tr: 许多人通过 401(k) 计划、IRA 和低成本指数基金持有市场。

segments.src: That is a sensible, diversified approach for many investors, but it is worth understanding what you actually hold.
segments.tr: 对许多投资者而言，这是一种明智且分散投资的方法，但有必要了解你实际上持有的是什么。

segments.src: Index funds can be more concentrated than they look.**
segments.tr: 指数基金可能比看起来更加集中。**

segments.src: A fund that tracks a cap-weighted index may put a large share of its assets in a small number of companies.
segments.tr: 跟踪市值加权指数的基金可能会将其很大一部分资产配置在极少数公司上。

segments.src: If you also hold a target-date fund, a large-cap growth fund and a Nasdaq 100 fund, your overlap in the same mega-caps may be bigger than you expect.
segments.tr: 如果你同时还持有目标日期基金、大盘成长型基金和纳斯达克100基金，你在相同超级大盘股上的重合度可能会超出你的预期。

segments.src: Concentration cuts both ways.**
segments.tr: 集中度是一把双刃剑。**

segments.src: When leaders keep rising, cap-weighted funds benefit.
segments.tr: 当领头羊持续上涨时，市值加权基金会受益。

segments.src: If leadership fades, those funds can feel it more than an equal-weighted or broadly diversified portfolio would.
segments.tr: 如果领头羊势头消退，这些基金受到的冲击会比等权重或广泛分散的投资组合更大。

segments.src: A record high is not a prediction.**
segments.tr: 历史新高并非预测。**

segments.src: Narrow markets can last longer than skeptics expect, and breadth can also improve without any sharp decline.
segments.tr: 窄幅市场持续的时间可能比怀疑者预期的更长，而且市场宽度也可能在没有任何大幅下跌的情况下得到改善。

segments.src: Weak breadth is a caution flag about the quality of a rally, not a timing signal.
segments.tr: 宽度不足是对上涨质量的警示，而不是买卖时机的信号。

segments.src: Time horizon matters.**
segments.tr: 时间跨度很重要。**

segments.src: Someone decades from retirement faces different risks than someone planning to withdraw funds within a few years.
segments.tr: 距离退休还有几十年的投资者与计划在几年内提取资金的投资者面临着不同的风险。

segments.src: Those closer to retirement may want to check whether their allocation still matches their tolerance for a drawdown.
segments.tr: 那些临近退休的人可能需要检查其资产配置是否仍然符合他们对回撤的承受能力。

segments.src: ## Practical steps worth considering
segments.tr: ## 值得考虑的实用步骤

segments.src: These are general habits, not personalized advice:
segments.tr: 这些是一般的习惯，而非针对个人的建议：

segments.src: - **Check your fund holdings.** Most providers list a fund's top ten holdings and sector weights. Add them up across your accounts to see your real exposure.
segments.tr: - **检查你的基金持仓。** 大多数基金公司会列出基金的前十大持仓和行业权重。在你的账户中将它们加总，以了解你的真实风险敞口。

segments.src: - **Review overlap.** Several funds with different names can own much of the same stocks.
segments.tr: - **审查重合度。** 几个名称不同的基金可能会持有大量相同的股票。

segments.src: - **Rebalance on a schedule.** If strong gains in one area have pushed your portfolio away from your target mix, rebalancing returns it to the level of risk you chose.
segments.tr: - **定期定期再平衡。** 如果某个领域的强劲涨幅使你的投资组合偏离了目标比例，进行再平衡可以使其恢复到你所选择的风险水平。

segments.src: - **Keep emergency savings separate.** Money you may need soon generally should not depend on stock market levels.
segments.tr: - **将应急资金单独存放。** 你近期可能需要的资金通常不应依赖于股市的水平。

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Staying consistent with a long-term plan often matters more than responding to each record or pullback.
segments.tr: - **避免对头条新闻作出情绪化反应。** 坚持长期计划通常比对每一次新高或回调作出反应更为重要。

segments.src: - **Consider speaking with a licensed financial professional** about your own goals, taxes and timeline.
segments.tr: - **考虑与持牌金融专业人士沟通**，探讨你个人的目标、税务和时间表。

segments.src: ## What to watch as earnings season begins
segments.tr: ## 财报季开始之际需要关注什么

segments.src: Quarterly reports give investors fresh evidence on whether the narrow leadership is justified and whether the laggards are stabilizing.
segments.tr: 季度报告为投资者提供了新的证据，证明狭窄的领涨是否合理，以及落后者是否正在企稳。

segments.src: Useful things to look for include:
segments.tr: 值得关注的有用事项包括：

segments.src: - **Mega-cap guidance:** Do technology and AI leaders show that spending and demand are translating into earnings growth?
segments.tr: - **超级大盘股的前瞻指引：** 科技和AI领头羊是否展示出支出和需求正在转化为盈利增长？

segments.src: - **Capital spending plans:** Large AI-related investment can support suppliers and cloud providers, but investors will watch for returns on that spending.
segments.tr: - **资本支出计划：** 与AI相关的庞大投资可以支持供应商和云服务提供商，但投资者将关注这些支出的回报率。

segments.src: - **Housing-related commentary:** Homebuilders and home-improvement retailers may discuss orders, pricing, incentives and the effect of mortgage rates.
segments.tr: - **房地产相关评论：** 房屋建筑商和家居装修零售商可能会讨论订单、定价、优惠措施以及抵押贷款利率的影响。

segments.src: - **Consumer trends:** Restaurant and retail results can show how households are responding to prices and borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **消费者趋势：** 餐饮和零售业绩可以展示家庭对物价和借贷成本的反应。

segments.src: - **Treasury yields:** Continued moves in yields can shift how investors value both growth and defensive stocks.
segments.tr: - **美债收益率：** 收益率的持续波动可能会改变投资者对成长股和防御性股票的估值方式。

segments.src: - **Breadth indicators:** If more stocks begin to join the advance, that would suggest the market's foundation is widening.
segments.tr: - **宽度指标：** 如果有更多的股票开始加入上涨行列，那将表明市场的基石正在拓宽。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: A record-setting Nasdaq 100 is real, and so is the fact that a relatively small group of companies is doing a lot of the work.
segments.tr: 纳斯达克100指数创下新高是事实，相对较小的一群公司承担了大量工作也是事实。

segments.src: For retirement savers and index-fund investors, the useful response is not alarm or excitement but awareness: know what your funds hold, understand how concentrated they may be, and make sure your portfolio still fits your goals and time horizon.
segments.tr: 对于养老金储蓄者和指数基金投资者来说，有用的应对方式不是恐慌或兴奋，而是保持觉察：了解你的基金持有甚么，理解它们可能的集中程度，并确保你的投资组合依然符合你的目标和时间跨度。

segments.src: Earnings season should offer more clues about whether the rally is broadening or staying narrow.
segments.tr: 财报季应该会提供更多线索，表明这场上涨是在拓宽还是继续保持狭窄。

segments.src: Breadth describes how many stocks take part in a market move.

segments.src: In a broad rally, most sectors and a large share of individual stocks rise together.

segments.tr: Los analistas suelen observar algunos indicadores simples:

segments.src: - **Stocks near highs versus lows:** how many index members sit close to 52-week highs compared with 52-week lows.
segments.tr: - **Acciones cerca de máximos frente a mínimos:** cuántos miembros del índice se sitúan cerca de máximos de 52 semanas en comparación con mínimos de 52 semanas.

segments.src: - **Equal-weight versus cap-weight performance:** whether the average stock is keeping pace with the market-cap-weighted index.
segments.tr: - **Rendimiento ponderado por igual frente a ponderado por capitalización:** si la acción promedio está manteniendo el ritmo del índice ponderado por capitalización de mercado.

segments.src: - **Share of stocks above their 200-day moving average:** a rough read on the health of the typical stock.
segments.tr: - **Porcentaje de acciones por encima de su media móvil de 200 días:** una lectura aproximada de la salud de la acción típica.

segments.src: When the headline index sets records while these gauges weaken, it is a sign that gains are concentrated.

segments.src: A few of the largest technology and AI-linked companies can therefore account for a very large share of an index's daily moves.
segments.tr: Por lo tanto, algunas de las empresas tecnológicas y vinculadas a la IA más grandes pueden representar una parte muy importante de los movimientos diarios de un índice.

segments.src: If those companies rally on enthusiasm for AI spending, cloud demand or strong profit forecasts, the index can rise even when most other members are flat or falling.
segments.tr: Si esas empresas suben debido al entusiasmo por el gasto en IA, la demanda de la nube o fuertes previsiones de beneficios, el índice puede subir incluso cuando la mayoría de los demás miembros están estancados o cayendo.

segments.src: The reverse also applies: a setback in a few leaders can pull the whole index lower, even when the rest of the market is steady.
segments.tr: Lo contrario también se aplica: un revés en unos pocos líderes puede arrastrar al índice completo hacia abajo, incluso cuando el resto del mercado está estable.

segments.src: ## The other side of the picture: pressure on rate-sensitive and consumer names
segments.tr: ## La otra cara de la moneda: presión sobre los nombres sensibles a las tasas y de consumo

segments.src: Rising Treasury yields help explain why some parts of the market are lagging.
segments.tr: El aumento de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro ayuda a explicar por qué algunas partes del mercado se están quedando atrás.

segments.src: Higher yields tend to affect companies in several ways:
segments.tr: Los rendimientos más altos tienden a afectar a las empresas de varias maneras:

segments.src: - **Housing and homebuilding:** Mortgage rates tend to follow longer-term yields. Higher borrowing costs can weigh on home purchases and on homebuilders such as Lennar.
segments.tr: - **Vivienda y construcción:** Las tasas hipotecarias tienden a seguir los rendimientos a más largo plazo. Los costos de endeudamiento más altos pueden afectar las compras de viviendas y a los constructores como Lennar.

segments.src: - **Home improvement:** Retailers like Lowe's can be sensitive to housing turnover and big-ticket renovation spending, both of which cool when financing becomes more expensive.
segments.tr: - **Mejoras para el hogar:** Los minoristas como Lowe's pueden ser sensibles a la rotación de viviendas y al gasto en renovaciones importantes, los cuales se enfrían cuando la financiación se vuelve más cara.

segments.src: - **Consumer spending:** Restaurant and food chains such as McDonald's depend on steady traffic. If households feel squeezed by higher prices or borrowing costs, they may trade down or visit less often.
segments.tr: - **Gasto del consumidor:** Las cadenas de restaurantes y alimentos como McDonald's dependen de un tráfico constante. Si los hogares se sienten presionados por precios más altos o costos de endeudamiento, pueden optar por opciones más económicas o visitar con menos frecuencia.

segments.src: - **Valuation math:** When "risk-free" Treasury yields rise, future profits are discounted more heavily, and stocks without fast growth can look less attractive by comparison.
segments.tr: - **Matemáticas de valoración:** Cuando los rendimientos "libres de riesgo" del Tesoro aumentan, los beneficios futuros se descuentan más fuertemente, y las acciones sin un crecimiento rápido pueden parecer menos atractivas en comparación.

segments.src: Each company has its own story, and a low share price alone does not tell you whether a business is struggling or simply out of favor.
segments.tr: Cada empresa tiene su propia historia, y un precio de acción bajo por sí solo no le dice si una empresa está luchando o simplemente fuera de favor.

segments.src: The broader point is that several familiar names are not participating in the index's strength.
segments.tr: El punto más amplio es que varios nombres familiares no están participando en la fortaleza del índice.

segments.src: ## What this means for retirement accounts and index-fund investors
segments.tr: ## Qué significa esto para las cuentas de jubilación y los inversores en fondos indexados

segments.src: Many people own the market through 401(k) plans, IRAs and low-cost index funds.
segments.tr: Muchas personas poseen el mercado a través de planes 401(k), IRA y fondos indexados de bajo costo.

segments.src: That is a sensible, diversified approach for many investors, but it is worth understanding what you actually hold.
segments.tr: Ese es un enfoque sensato y diversificado para muchos inversores, pero vale la pena entender lo que realmente posee.

segments.src: Index funds can be more concentrated than they look.**
segments.tr: Los fondos indexados pueden estar más concentrados de lo que parecen.**

segments.src: A fund that tracks a cap-weighted index may put a large share of its assets in a small number of companies.
segments.tr: Un fondo que sigue un índice ponderado por capitalización puede poner una gran parte de sus activos en un pequeño número de empresas.

segments.src: If you also hold a target-date fund, a large-cap growth fund and a Nasdaq 100 fund, your overlap in the same mega-caps may be bigger than you expect.
segments.tr: Si también posee un fondo con fecha objetivo, un fondo de crecimiento de gran capitalización y un fondo Nasdaq 100, su superposición en las mismas megacapitalizaciones puede ser mayor de lo que espera.

segments.src: Concentration cuts both ways.**
segments.tr: La concentración funciona en ambos sentidos.**

segments.src: When leaders keep rising, cap-weighted funds benefit.
segments.tr: Cuando los líderes siguen subiendo, los fondos ponderados por capitalización se benefician.

segments.src: If leadership fades, those funds can feel it more than an equal-weighted or broadly diversified portfolio would.
segments.tr: Si el liderazgo se desvanece, esos fondos pueden sentirlo más que una cartera ponderada por igual o ampliamente diversificada.

segments.src: A record high is not a prediction.**
segments.tr: Un máximo histórico no es una predicción.**

segments.src: Narrow markets can last longer than skeptics expect, and breadth can also improve without any sharp decline.
segments.tr: Los mercados estrechos pueden durar más de lo que esperan los escépticos, y la amplitud también puede mejorar sin ninguna caída brusca.

segments.src: Weak breadth is a caution flag about the quality of a rally, not a timing signal.
segments.tr: La amplitud débil es una bandera de advertencia sobre la calidad de un repunte, no una señal de sincronización.

segments.src: Time horizon matters.**
segments.tr: El horizonte temporal importa.**

segments.src: Someone decades from retirement faces different risks than someone planning to withdraw funds within a few years.
segments.tr: Alguien a décadas de la jubilación enfrenta riesgos diferentes a alguien que planea retirar fondos en unos pocos años.

segments.src: Those closer to retirement may want to check whether their allocation still matches their tolerance for a drawdown.
segments.tr: Aquellos más cercanos a la jubilación pueden querer verificar si su asignación aún coincide con su tolerancia a una caída.

segments.src: ## Practical steps worth considering
segments.tr: ## Pasos prácticos que vale la pena considerar

segments.src: These are general habits, not personalized advice:
segments.tr: Estos son hábitos generales, no consejos personalizados:

segments.src: - **Check your fund holdings.** Most providers list a fund's top ten holdings and sector weights. Add them up across your accounts to see your real exposure.
segments.tr: - **Verifique las tenencias de su fondo.** La mayoría de los proveedores enumeran las diez principales tenencias y las ponderaciones sectoriales de un fondo. Súmelos en todas sus cuentas para ver su exposición real.

segments.src: - **Review overlap.** Several funds with different names can own much of the same stocks.
segments.tr: - **Revise la superposición.** Varios fondos con nombres diferentes pueden poseer gran parte de las mismas acciones.

segments.src: - **Rebalance on a schedule.** If strong gains in one area have pushed your portfolio away from your target mix, rebalancing returns it to the level of risk you chose.
segments.tr: - **Reequilibre según un cronograma.** Si las fuertes ganancias en un área han alejado su cartera de su combinación objetivo, el reequilibrio la devuelve al nivel de riesgo que eligió.

segments.src: - **Keep emergency savings separate.** Money you may need soon generally should not depend on stock market levels.
segments.tr: - **Mantenga los ahorros de emergencia separados.** El dinero que pueda necesitar pronto generalmente no debería depender de los niveles del mercado de valores.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Staying consistent with a long-term plan often matters more than responding to each record or pullback.
segments.tr: - **Evite reaccionar a los titulares.** Mantenerse constante con un plan a largo plazo a menudo importa más que responder a cada récord o retroceso.

segments.src: - **Consider speaking with a licensed financial professional** about your own goals, taxes and timeline.
segments.tr: - **Considere hablar con un profesional financiero con licencia** sobre sus propios objetivos, impuestos y cronograma.

segments.src: ## What to watch as earnings season begins
segments.tr: ## Qué observar a medida que comienza la temporada de resultados

segments.src: Quarterly reports give investors fresh evidence on whether the narrow leadership is justified and whether the laggards are stabilizing.
segments.tr: Los informes trimestrales brindan a los inversores nueva evidencia sobre si el liderazgo estrecho está justificado y si los rezagados se están estabilizando.

segments.src: Useful things to look for include:
segments.tr: Las cosas útiles a buscar incluyen:

segments.src: - **Mega-cap guidance:** Do technology and AI leaders show that spending and demand are translating into earnings growth?
segments.tr: - **Guía de megacapitalizaciones:** ¿Los líderes tecnológicos y de IA muestran que el gasto y la demanda se están traduciendo en crecimiento de beneficios?

segments.src: - **Capital spending plans:** Large AI-related investment can support suppliers and cloud providers, but investors will watch for returns on that spending.
segments.tr: - **Planes de gasto de capital:** La gran inversión relacionada con la IA puede apoyar a los proveedores y proveedores de la nube, pero los inversores estarán atentos a los rendimientos de ese gasto.

segments.src: - **Housing-related commentary:** Homebuilders and home-improvement retailers may discuss orders, pricing, incentives and the effect of mortgage rates.
segments.tr: - **Comentarios relacionados con la vivienda:** Los constructores de viviendas y los minoristas de mejoras para el hogar pueden discutir pedidos, precios, incentivos y el efecto de las tasas hipotecarias.

segments.src: - **Consumer trends:** Restaurant and retail results can show how households are responding to prices and borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **Tendencias de consumo:** Los resultados de restaurantes y minoristas pueden mostrar cómo los hogares están respondiendo a los precios y costos de endeudamiento.

segments.src: - **Treasury yields:** Continued moves in yields can shift how investors value both growth and defensive stocks.
segments.tr: - **Rendimientos del Tesoro:** Los movimientos continuos en los rendimientos pueden cambiar cómo los inversores valoran tanto las acciones de crecimiento como las defensivas.

segments.src: - **Breadth indicators:** If more stocks begin to join the advance, that would suggest the market's foundation is widening.
segments.tr: - **Indicadores de amplitud:** Si más acciones comienzan a unirse al avance, eso sugeriría que la base del mercado se está ampliando.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: A record-setting Nasdaq 100 is real, and so is the fact that a relatively small group of companies is doing a lot of the work.
segments.tr: Un Nasdaq 100 que establece récords es real, y también lo es el hecho de que un grupo relativamente pequeño de empresas está haciendo gran parte del trabajo.

segments.src: For retirement savers and index-fund investors, the useful response is not alarm or excitement but awareness: know what your funds hold, understand how concentrated they may be, and make sure your portfolio still fits your goals and time horizon.
segments.tr: Para los ahorradores de jubilación y los inversores en fondos indexados, la respuesta útil no es alarma o entusiasmo, sino conciencia: sepa lo que contienen sus fondos, comprenda cuán concentrados pueden estar y asegúrese de que su cartera aún se ajuste a sus objetivos y horizonte temporal.

segments.src: Earnings season should offer more clues about whether the rally is broadening or staying narrow.
segments.tr: La temporada de resultados debería ofrecer más pistas sobre si el repunte se está ampliando o manteniéndose estrecho.

segments.src: A small group of technology and artificial intelligence mega-caps is doing much of the lifting.

segments.src: Meanwhile, well-known consumer and housing-related companies such as Lennar, Lowe's and McDonald's have been trading near their 52-week lows, and Treasury yields have been climbing.

segments.src: ## What "market breadth" actually measures
segments.tr: ## ما يقيسه "اتساع السوق" في الواقع

segments.src: Breadth describes how many stocks take part in a market move.
segments.tr: يصف الاتساع عدد الأسهم التي تشارك في حركة السوق.

segments.src: In a broad rally, most sectors and a large share of individual stocks rise together.
segments.tr: في الارتفاع الواسع، ترتفع معظم القطاعات ونسبة كبيرة من الأسهم الفردية معاً.

segments.src: In a narrow rally, the index climbs because a handful of very large companies are rising, while many others stall or fall.
segments.tr: في الارتفاع الضيق، يصعد المؤشر لأن حفنة من الشركات الكبيرة جداً ترتفع، بينما تتوقف العديد من الشركات الأخرى أو تنخفض.

segments.src: Analysts usually look at a few simple gauges:
segments.tr: ينظر المحللون عادة إلى عدد من المقاييس البسيطة:

segments.src: - **Advancers versus decliners:** how many stocks rose compared with how many fell on a given day or week.
segments.tr: - **الأسهم الصاعدة مقابل الهابطة:** عدد الأسهم التي ارتفعت مقارنة بعدد الأسهم التي انخفضت في يوم أو أسبوع معين.

segments.src: - **Stocks near highs versus lows:** how many index members sit close to 52-week highs compared with 52-week lows.
segments.tr: - **الأسهم القريبة من المستويات المرتفعة مقابل المنخفضة:** عدد أعضاء المؤشر القريبين من مستويات 52 أسبوعاً المرتفعة مقارنة بمستويات 52 أسبوعاً المنخفضة.

segments.src: - **Equal-weight versus cap-weight performance:** whether the average stock is keeping pace with the market-cap-weighted index.
segments.tr: - **أداء الوزن المتساوي مقابل الوزن النسبي للقيمة السوقية:** ما إذا كان السهم المتوسط يواكب مؤشر القيمة السوقية المرجحة.

segments.src: - **Share of stocks above their 200-day moving average:** a rough read on the health of the typical stock.
segments.tr: - **نسبة الأسهم فوق متوسطها المتحرك لـ 200 يوم:** قراءة تقريبية لصحة السهم النموذجي.

segments.src: When the headline index sets records while these gauges weaken, it is a sign that gains are concentrated.
segments.tr: عندما يسجل المؤشر الرئيسي مستويات قياسية بينما تضعف هذه المقاييس، فهذه علامة على أن المكاسب مركزة.

segments.src: ## Why a few giants can move the whole index
segments.tr: ## لماذا يمكن لبعض العمالقة تحريك المؤشر بأكمله

segments.src: Most major U.S.
segments.tr: معظم مؤشرات الأسهم الأمريكية الرئيسية،

segments.src: indexes, including the Nasdaq 100 and the S&P 500, are **market-cap weighted**.
segments.tr: بما في ذلك ناسداك 100 وستاندرد آند بورز 500، هي **مرجحة بالقيمة السوقية**.

segments.src: The bigger a company's market value, the more influence it has on the index.
segments.tr: كلما زادت القيمة السوقية للشركة، كان لها تأثير أكبر على المؤشر.

segments.src: A few of the largest technology and AI-linked companies can therefore account for a very large share of an index's daily moves.
segments.tr: لذلك يمكن لعدد قليل من أكبر شركات التكنولوجيا والذكاء الاصطناعي أن تمثل نسبة كبيرة جداً من تحركات المؤشر اليومية.

segments.src: If those companies rally on enthusiasm for AI spending, cloud demand or strong profit forecasts, the index can rise even when most other members are flat or falling.
segments.tr: إذا انتعشت تلك الشركات بسبب الحماس لإنفاق الذكاء الاصطناعي، أو الطلب على الحوسبة السحابية، أو توقعات الأرباح القوية، فيمكن للمؤشر أن يرتفع حتى عندما يكون معظم الأعضاء الآخرين ثابتين أو منخفضين.

segments.src: The reverse also applies: a setback in a few leaders can pull the whole index lower, even when the rest of the market is steady.
segments.tr: وينطبق العكس أيضاً: يمكن أن يؤدي أي تراجع لدى عدد قليل من الشركات القيادية إلى سحب المؤشر بأكمله إلى أسفل، حتى عندما يظل باقي السوق مستقراً.

segments.src: ## The other side of the picture: pressure on rate-sensitive and consumer names
segments.tr: ## الجانب الآخر من الصورة: الضغط على الأسماء الحساسة لأسعار الفائدة والمستهلكين

segments.src: - **Home improvement:** Retailers like Lowe's can be sensitive to housing turnover and big-ticket renovation spending, both of which cool when financing becomes more expensive.

segments.src: - **Consumer spending:** Restaurant and food chains such as McDonald's depend on steady traffic. If households feel squeezed by higher prices or borrowing costs, they may trade down or visit less often.
segments.tr: - **إنفاق المستهلكين:** تعتمد سلاسل المطاعم والأغذية مثل McDonald's على حركة مرور ثابتة. إذا شعرت الأسر بضغوط بسبب ارتفاع الأسعار أو تكاليف الاقتراض، فقد تلجأ إلى خيارات أرخص أو تقلل الزيارات.

segments.src: - **Valuation math:** When "risk-free" Treasury yields rise, future profits are discounted more heavily, and stocks without fast growth can look less attractive by comparison.
segments.tr: - **رياضيات التقييم:** عندما ترتفع عوائد سندات الخزانة "الخالية من المخاطر"، يتم خصم الأرباح المستقبلية بشكل أكبر، وقد تبدو الأسهم التي لا تتمتع بنمو سريع أقل جاذبية بالمقارنة.

segments.src: Each company has its own story, and a low share price alone does not tell you whether a business is struggling or simply out of favor.

segments.src: The broader point is that several familiar names are not participating in the index's strength.
segments.tr: النقطة الأوسع هي أن العديد من الأسماء المألوفة لا تشارك في قوة المؤشر.

segments.src: ## What this means for retirement accounts and index-fund investors
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا لحسابات التقاعد ومستثمري صناديق المؤشرات

segments.src: That is a sensible, diversified approach for many investors, but it is worth understanding what you actually hold.

segments.tr: يمكن أن تكون صناديق المؤشرات أكثر تركيزاً مما تبدو عليه.**

segments.tr: إذا تراجعت تلك القيادة، يمكن لتلك الصناديق أن تشعر بالأمر أكثر مما لو كان محفظة موزونة بالتساوي أو متنوعة على نطاق واسع.

segments.tr: الرقم القياسي ليس تنبؤاً.**

segments.src: Narrow markets can last longer than skeptics expect, and breadth can also improve without any sharp decline.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تستمر الأسواق الضيقة لفترة أطول مما يتوقع المتشككون، ويمكن أن يتحسن الاتساع أيضاً دون أي هبوط حاد.

segments.src: Weak breadth is a caution flag about the quality of a rally, not a timing signal.
segments.tr: ضعف الاتساع هو علامة تحذير حول جودة الارتفاع، وليس إشارة توقيت.

segments.src: Time horizon matters.**
segments.tr: الأفق الزمني مهم.**

segments.src: Someone decades from retirement faces different risks than someone planning to withdraw funds within a few years.
segments.tr: الشخص الذي يفصله عقود عن التقاعد يواجه مخاطر مختلفة عن شخص يخطط لسحب الأموال في غضون بضع سنوات.

segments.src: Those closer to retirement may want to check whether their allocation still matches their tolerance for a drawdown.
segments.tr: قد يرغب أولئك الأقرب للتقاعد في التحقق مما إذا كانت مخصصاتهم لا تزال تتطابق مع قدرتهم على تحمل الانخفاض.

segments.src: ## Practical steps worth considering
segments.tr: ## خطوات عملية تستحق النظر فيها

segments.src: These are general habits, not personalized advice:
segments.tr: هذه عادات عامة وليست نصيحة شخصية:

segments.src: - **Check your fund holdings.** Most providers list a fund's top ten holdings and sector weights. Add them up across your accounts to see your real exposure.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من حيازات الصندوق.** يسرد معظم مزودي الخدمات أفضل عشر حيازات للصندوق وأوزان القطاعات. اجمعها عبر حساباتك لمعرفة تعرضك الحقيقي.

segments.src: - **Review overlap.** Several funds with different names can own much of the same stocks.
segments.tr: - **راجع التداخل.** يمكن للعديد من الصناديق ذات الأسماء المختلفة أن تمتلك الكثير من نفس الأسهم.

segments.src: - **Rebalance on a schedule.** If strong gains in one area have pushed your portfolio away from your target mix, rebalancing returns it to the level of risk you chose.
segments.tr: - **إعادة التوازن وفقاً لجدول زمني.** إذا دفعت المكاسب القوية في منطقة ما محفظتك بعيداً عن المزيج المستهدف، فإن إعادة التوازن تعيدها إلى مستوى المخاطر الذي اخترته.

segments.src: - **Keep emergency savings separate.** Money you may need soon generally should not depend on stock market levels.
segments.tr: - **اجعل المدخرات الطارئة منفصلة.** الأموال التي قد تحتاجها قريباً يجب ألا تعتمد بشكل عام على مستويات سوق الأسهم.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Staying consistent with a long-term plan often matters more than responding to each record or pullback.
segments.tr: - **تجنب التفاعل مع عناوين الأخبار.** البقاء متسقاً مع خطة طويلة الأجل غالباً ما يكون أكثر أهمية من الاستجابة لكل رقم قياسي أو تراجع.

segments.src: - **Consider speaking with a licensed financial professional** about your own goals, taxes and timeline.
segments.tr: - **فكر في التحدث مع محترف مالي مرخص** بشأن أهدافك وضرائبك وجدولك الزمني.

segments.src: ## What to watch as earnings season begins
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته مع بدء موسم أرباح الشركات

segments.src: Quarterly reports give investors fresh evidence on whether the narrow leadership is justified and whether the laggards are stabilizing.
segments.tr: تقدم التقارير الفصلية للمستثمرين أدلة جديدة حول ما إذا كانت القيادة الضيقة مبررة وما إذا كانت الشركات المتخلفة تتثبت.

segments.src: Useful things to look for include:
segments.tr: تشمل الأمور المفيدة التي يجب البحث عنها ما يلي:

segments.src: - **Mega-cap guidance:** Do technology and AI leaders show that spending and demand are translating into earnings growth?
segments.tr: - **توجيهات الشركات الكبرى:** هل تظهر شركات التكنولوجيا والذكاء الاصطناعي الرائدة أن الإنفاق والطلب يترجمان إلى نمو في الأرباح؟

segments.src: - **Capital spending plans:** Large AI-related investment can support suppliers and cloud providers, but investors will watch for returns on that spending.
segments.tr: - **خطط الإنفاق الرأسمالي:** يمكن للاستثمار الكبير المرتبط بالذكاء الاصطناعي أن يدعم الموردين ومزودي الحوسبة السحابية، لكن المستثمرين سيراقبون العوائد على هذا الإنفاق.

segments.src: - **Housing-related commentary:** Homebuilders and home-improvement retailers may discuss orders, pricing, incentives and the effect of mortgage rates.
segments.tr: - **التعليقات المتعلقة بالإسكان:** قد تناقش شركات بناء المنازل وت تجار تجزئة تحسين المنازل الطلبات والأسعار والحوافز وتأثير أسعار الفائدة على الرهن العقاري.

segments.src: - **Consumer trends:** Restaurant and retail results can show how households are responding to prices and borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **اتجاهات المستهلكين:** يمكن لنتائج المطاعم والتجزئة أن تُظهر كيف تستجيب الأسر للأسعار وتكاليف الاقتراض.

segments.src: - **Treasury yields:** Continued moves in yields can shift how investors value both growth and defensive stocks.
segments.tr: - **عوائد سندات الخزانة:** يمكن للتحركات المستمرة في العوائد أن تغير كيفية تقييم المستثمرين لكل من أسهم النمو والأسهم الدفاعية.

segments.src: - **Breadth indicators:** If more stocks begin to join the advance, that would suggest the market's foundation is widening.
segments.tr: - **مؤشرات الاتساع:** إذا بدأت المزيد من الأسهم في الانضمام إلى الارتفاع، فسيشير ذلك إلى أن أساس السوق آخذ في الاتساع.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: A record-setting Nasdaq 100 is real, and so is the fact that a relatively small group of companies is doing a lot of the work.
segments.tr: مؤشر ناسداك 100 الذي يسجل مستويات قياسية هو أمر حقيقي، وكذلك حقيقة أن مجموعة صغيرة نسبياً من الشركات تقوم بالكثير من العمل.

segments.src: For retirement savers and index-fund investors, the useful response is not alarm or excitement but awareness: know what your funds hold, understand how concentrated they may be, and make sure your portfolio still fits your goals and time horizon.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لمدخري التقاعد ومستثمري صناديق المؤشرات، فإن الاستجابة المفيدة ليست الذعر أو الإثارة بل الوعي: اعلم ما تحتويه صناديقك، وافهم مدى تركيزها المحتمل، وتأكد من أن محفظتك لا تزال تتناسب مع أهدافك وأفقك الزمني.

fr.title: Un Nasdaq record, un marché étroit : pourquoi un plus petit nombre d'actions portent Wall Street

segments.src: The headline looks great: the Nasdaq 100 is back at record highs.
segments.tr: Le titre a fière allure : le Nasdaq 100 est de retour à des niveaux records.

segments.src: Look underneath it, though, and the picture is more mixed.
segments.tr: Regardez sous la surface, cependant, et le tableau est plus contrasté.

segments.src: A small group of technology and artificial intelligence mega-caps is doing much of the lifting.
segments.tr: Un petit groupe de méga-capitalisations de la technologie et de l'intelligence artificielle fait l'essentiel du travail.

segments.src: Meanwhile, well-known consumer and housing-related companies such as Lennar, Lowe's and McDonald's have been trading near their 52-week lows, and Treasury yields have been climbing.
segments.tr: Pendant ce temps, des entreprises de grande consommation et liées à l'habitat bien connues telles que Lennar, Lowe's et McDonald's se négocient près de leurs plus bas sur 52 semaines, et les rendements obligataires ont grimpé.

segments.src: This pattern is often called **narrow market breadth**.
segments.tr: Ce schéma est souvent appelé **largeur de marché étroite**.

segments.src: This article explains what it means, why it matters for ordinary savers, and what to watch as earnings season begins.
segments.tr: Cet article explique ce que cela signifie, pourquoi c'est important pour les épargnants ordinaires, et ce qu'il faut surveiller à l'approche de la saison des résultats.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *Cet article est fourni à des fins d'information générale uniquement.

segments.src: It is not investment advice, and it does not recommend buying or selling any security.*
segments.tr: Il ne constitue pas un conseil en investissement et ne recommande pas d'acheter ou de vendre un quelconque titre.*

segments.src: ## What "market breadth" actually measures
segments.tr: ## Ce que mesure réellement la "largeur du marché"

segments.src: Breadth describes how many stocks take part in a market move.
segments.tr: La largeur décrit combien d'actions participent à un mouvement de marché.

segments.src: In a broad rally, most sectors and a large share of individual stocks rise together.
segments.tr: Dans une hausse généralisée, la plupart des secteurs et une large part des actions individuelles progressent ensemble.

segments.src: In a narrow rally, the index climbs because a handful of very large companies are rising, while many others stall or fall.
segments.tr: Dans une hausse étroite, l'indice grimpe parce qu'une poignée de très grandes entreprises progressent, tandis que beaucoup d'autres stagnent ou chutent.

segments.src: Analysts usually look at a few simple gauges:
segments.tr: Les analystes examinent généralement quelques indicateurs simples :

segments.src: - **Advancers versus decliners:** how many stocks rose compared with how many fell on a given day or week.
segments.tr: - **Valeurs en hausse par rapport aux valeurs en baisse :** combien d'actions ont progressé par rapport à celles qui ont baissé sur un jour ou une semaine donnée.

segments.src: - **Stocks near highs versus lows:** how many index members sit close to 52-week highs compared with 52-week lows.
segments.tr: - **Actions proches des plus hauts par rapport aux plus bas :** combien de membres de l'indice se situent près de leurs sommets sur 52 semaines par rapport à leurs creux sur 52 semaines.

segments.src: - **Equal-weight versus cap-weight performance:** whether the average stock is keeping pace with the market-cap-weighted index.
segments.tr: - **Performance équipondérée par rapport à la capitalisation boursière :** si l'action moyenne suit le rythme de l'indice pondéré par la capitalisation boursière.

segments.src: - **Share of stocks above their 200-day moving average:** a rough read on the health of the typical stock.
segments.tr: - **Part des actions au-dessus de leur moyenne mobile à 200 jours :** une lecture approximative de la santé de l'action typique.

segments.src: When the headline index sets records while these gauges weaken, it is a sign that gains are concentrated.
segments.tr: Lorsque l'indice phare établit des records alors que ces indicateurs s'affaiblissent, c'est le signe que les gains sont concentrés.

segments.src: ## Why a few giants can move the whole index
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi quelques géants peuvent faire bouger l'indice entier

segments.src: Most major U.S.
segments.tr: La plupart des principaux indices américains,

segments.src: indexes, including the Nasdaq 100 and the S&P 500, are **market-cap weighted**.
segments.tr: y compris le Nasdaq 100 et le S&P 500, sont **pondérés par la capitalisation boursière**.

segments.src: The bigger a company's market value, the more influence it has on the index.
segments.tr: Plus la valeur boursière d'une entreprise est grande, plus elle a d'influence sur l'indice.

segments.src: A few of the largest technology and AI-linked companies can therefore account for a very large share of an index's daily moves.
segments.tr: Quelques-unes des plus grandes entreprises technologiques et liées à l'IA peuvent donc représenter une part très importante des mouvements quotidiens d'un indice.

segments.src: If those companies rally on enthusiasm for AI spending, cloud demand or strong profit forecasts, the index can rise even when most other members are flat or falling.
segments.tr: Si ces entreprises progressent grâce à l'enthousiasme pour les dépenses en IA, la demande pour le cloud ou de solides prévisions de bénéfices, l'indice peut monter même lorsque la plupart des autres membres stagnent ou baissent.

segments.src: The reverse also applies: a setback in a few leaders can pull the whole index lower, even when the rest of the market is steady.
segments.tr: L'inverse est également vrai : un recul de quelques leaders peut entraîner l'ensemble de l'indice vers le bas, même lorsque le reste du marché est stable.

segments.src: ## The other side of the picture: pressure on rate-sensitive and consumer names
segments.tr: ## L'autre facette du tableau : la pression sur les valeurs sensibles aux taux et à la consommation

segments.src: Rising Treasury yields help explain why some parts of the market are lagging.
segments.tr: La hausse des rendements obligataires aide à expliquer pourquoi certaines parties du marché sont à la traîne.

segments.src: Higher yields tend to affect companies in several ways:
segments.tr: Des rendements plus élevés ont tendance à affecter les entreprises de plusieurs manières :

segments.src: - **Housing and homebuilding:** Mortgage rates tend to follow longer-term yields. Higher borrowing costs can weigh on home purchases and on homebuilders such as Lennar.
segments.tr: - **Immobilier et construction résidentielle :** Les taux hypothécaires ont tendance à suivre les rendements à long terme. Des coûts d'emprunt plus élevés peuvent peser sur l'achat de logements et sur les constructeurs de maisons tels que Lennar.

segments.src: - **Home improvement:** Retailers like Lowe's can be sensitive to housing turnover and big-ticket renovation spending, both of which cool when financing becomes more expensive.
segments.tr: - **Amélioration de l'habitat :** Des détaillants comme Lowe's peuvent être sensibles à la rotation immobilière et aux dépenses de rénovation importantes, qui se refroidissent toutes deux lorsque le financement devient plus cher.

segments.src: - **Consumer spending:** Restaurant and food chains such as McDonald's depend on steady traffic. If households feel squeezed by higher prices or borrowing costs, they may trade down or visit less often.
segments.tr: - **Dépenses de consommation :** Les chaînes de restaurants et d'alimentation telles que McDonald's dépendent d'un trafic régulier. Si les ménages se sentent étouffés par des prix ou des coûts d'emprunt plus élevés, ils peuvent opter pour des alternatives moins chères ou visiter moins souvent.

segments.src: - **Valuation math:** When "risk-free" Treasury yields rise, future profits are discounted more heavily, and stocks without fast growth can look less attractive by comparison.
segments.tr: - **Mathématiques de la valorisation :** Lorsque les rendements "sans risque" des obligations augmentent, les bénéfices futurs sont actualisés plus lourdement, et les actions sans croissance rapide peuvent paraître moins attrayantes en comparaison.

segments.src: Each company has its own story, and a low share price alone does not tell you whether a business is struggling or simply out of favor.
segments.tr: Chaque entreprise a sa propre histoire, et un cours de bourse bas ne suffit pas à dire si une entreprise est en difficulté ou simplement boudée.

segments.src: The broader point is that several familiar names are not participating in the index's strength.
segments.tr: L'idée générale est que plusieurs noms familiers ne participent pas à la force de l'indice.

segments.src: ## What this means for retirement accounts and index-fund investors
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les comptes de retraite et les investisseurs en fonds indiciels

segments.src: Many people own the market through 401(k) plans, IRAs and low-cost index funds.
segments.tr: Beaucoup de gens détiennent le marché par le biais de plans 401(k), de comptes IRA et de fonds indiciels à faible coût.

segments.src: That is a sensible, diversified approach for many investors, but it is worth understanding what you actually hold.
segments.tr: C'est une approche judicieuse et diversifiée pour de nombreux investisseurs, mais il est utile de comprendre ce que vous détenez réellement.

segments.src: Index funds can be more concentrated than they look.**
segments.tr: Les fonds indiciels peuvent être plus concentrés qu'ils n'en ont l'air.**

segments.src: A fund that tracks a cap-weighted index may put a large share of its assets in a small number of companies.
segments.tr: Un fonds qui suit un indice pondéré par la capitalisation peut placer une grande partie de ses actifs dans un petit nombre d'entreprises.

segments.src: If you also hold a target-date fund, a large-cap growth fund and a Nasdaq 100 fund, your overlap in the same mega-caps may be bigger than you expect.
segments.tr: Si vous détenez également un fonds à date cible, un fonds de croissance à grande capitalisation et un fonds Nasdaq 100, votre chevauchement dans les mêmes méga-capitalisations pourrait être plus important que vous ne le pensez.

segments.src: Concentration cuts both ways.**
segments.tr: La concentration est une arme à double tranchant.**

segments.src: When leaders keep rising, cap-weighted funds benefit.
segments.tr: Lorsque les leaders continuent de progresser, les fonds pondérés par la capitalisation en profitent.

segments.src: If leadership fades, those funds can feel it more than an equal-weighted or broadly diversified portfolio would.
segments.tr: Si le leadership s'affaiblit, ces fonds peuvent le ressentir davantage qu'un portefeuille équipondéré ou largement diversifié ne le ferait.

segments.src: A record high is not a prediction.**
segments.tr: Un sommet historique n'est pas une prédiction.**

segments.src: Narrow markets can last longer than skeptics expect, and breadth can also improve without any sharp decline.
segments.tr: Les marchés étroits peuvent durer plus longtemps que ne le prévoient les sceptiques, et la largeur peut aussi s'améliorer sans qu'il y ait de baisse brutale.

segments.src: Weak breadth is a caution flag about the quality of a rally, not a timing signal.
segments.tr: Une faible largeur est un signal d'avertissement concernant la qualité d'une hausse, et non un signal de timing.

segments.src: Time horizon matters.**
segments.tr: L'horizon temporel compte.**

segments.src: Someone decades from retirement faces different risks than someone planning to withdraw funds within a few years.
segments.tr: Quelqu'un à des décennies de la retraite fait face à des risques différents de quelqu'un qui prévoit de retirer des fonds d'ici quelques années.

segments.src: Those closer to retirement may want to check whether their allocation still matches their tolerance for a drawdown.
segments.tr: Ceux qui sont plus proches de la retraite voudront peut-être vérifier si leur allocation correspond toujours à leur tolérance face à une baisse.

segments.src: ## Practical steps worth considering
segments.tr: ## Mesures pratiques à considérer

segments.src: These are general habits, not personalized advice:
segments.tr: Ce sont des habitudes générales, pas des conseils personnalisés :

segments.src: - **Check your fund holdings.** Most providers list a fund's top ten holdings and sector weights. Add them up across your accounts to see your real exposure.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez les avoirs de vos fonds.** La plupart des fournisseurs répertorient les dix principales positions et pondérations sectorielles d'un fonds. Additionnez-les à travers vos comptes pour voir votre exposition réelle.

segments.src: - **Review overlap.** Several funds with different names can own much of the same stocks.
segments.tr: - **Examinez les chevauchements.** Plusieurs fonds portant des noms différents peuvent détenir bon nombre des mêmes actions.

segments.src: - **Rebalance on a schedule.** If strong gains in one area have pushed your portfolio away from your target mix, rebalancing returns it to the level of risk you chose.
segments.tr: - **Rééquilibrez selon un calendrier.** Si de fortes hausses dans un domaine ont éloigné votre portefeuille de votre mélange cible, le rééquilibrage le ramène au niveau de risque que vous avez choisi.

segments.src: - **Keep emergency savings separate.** Money you may need soon generally should not depend on stock market levels.
segments.tr: - **Gardez l'épargne de précaution séparée.** L'argent dont vous pourriez avoir besoin prochainement ne devrait généralement pas dépendre des niveaux du marché boursier.

segments.src: - **Avoid reacting to headlines.** Staying consistent with a long-term plan often matters more than responding to each record or pullback.
segments.tr: - **Évitez de réagir aux gros titres.** Rester cohérent avec un plan à long terme importe souvent plus que de réagir à chaque record ou repli.

segments.src: - **Consider speaking with a licensed financial professional** about your own goals, taxes and timeline.
segments.tr: - **Envisagez de parler à un professionnel financier agréé** de vos propres objectifs, impôts et calendrier.

segments.src: ## What to watch as earnings season begins
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller à l'approche de la saison des résultats

segments.src: Quarterly reports give investors fresh evidence on whether the narrow leadership is justified and whether the laggards are stabilizing.
segments.tr: Les rapports trimestriels fournissent aux investisseurs de nouvelles preuves pour savoir si le leadership étroit est justifié et si les retardataires se stabilisent.

segments.src: Useful things to look for include:
segments.tr: Les éléments utiles à rechercher incluent :

segments.src: - **Mega-cap guidance:** Do technology and AI leaders show that spending and demand are translating into earnings growth?
segments.tr: - **Prévisions des méga-capitalisations :** Les leaders de la technologie et de l'IA montrent-ils que les dépenses et la demande se traduisent par une croissance des bénéfices ?

segments.src: - **Capital spending plans:** Large AI-related investment can support suppliers and cloud providers, but investors will watch for returns on that spending.
segments.tr: - **Plans de dépenses en capital :** Les investissements importants liés à l'IA peuvent soutenir les fournisseurs et les prestataires de cloud, mais les investisseurs surveilleront le rendement de ces dépenses.

segments.src: - **Housing-related commentary:** Homebuilders and home-improvement retailers may discuss orders, pricing, incentives and the effect of mortgage rates.
segments.tr: - **Commentaires liés à l'immobilier :** Les constructeurs de maisons et les détaillants d'amélioration de l'habitat peuvent discuter des commandes, des prix, des incitations et de l'effet des taux hypothécaires.

segments.src: - **Consumer trends:** Restaurant and retail results can show how households are responding to prices and borrowing costs.
segments.tr: - **Tendances de consommation :** Les résultats des restaurants et de la vente au détail peuvent montrer comment les ménages réagissent aux prix et aux coûts d'emprunt.

segments.src: - **Treasury yields:** Continued moves in yields can shift how investors value both growth and defensive stocks.
segments.tr: - **Rendements obligataires :** Les mouvements continus des rendements peuvent modifier la façon dont les investisseurs valorisent à la fois les actions de croissance et les actions défensives.

segments.src: - **Breadth indicators:** If more stocks begin to join the advance, that would suggest the market's foundation is widening.
segments.tr: - **Indicateurs de largeur :** Si un plus grand nombre d'actions commencent à se joindre à la hausse, cela suggérerait que les fondations du marché s'élargissent.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: A record-setting Nasdaq 100 is real, and so is the fact that a relatively small group of companies is doing a lot of the work.

pt.title: Um Nasdaq recorde, um mercado restrito: por que menos ações estão sustentando Wall Street

segments.src: The headline looks great: the Nasdaq 100 is back at record highs.
segments.tr: A manchete parece ótima: o Nasdaq 100 está de volta a níveis recordes.

segments.src: Look underneath it, though, and the picture is more mixed.
segments.tr: Olhe por baixo disso, no entanto, e o cenário é mais misto.

segments.src: A small group of technology and artificial intelligence mega-caps is doing much of the lifting.
segments.tr: Um pequeno grupo de mega-caps de tecnologia e inteligência artificial está fazendo grande parte do trabalho pesado.

segments.src: Meanwhile, well-known consumer and housing-related companies such as Lennar, Lowe's and McDonald's have been trading near their 52-week lows, and Treasury yields have been climbing.
segments.tr: Enquanto isso, empresas conhecidas de consumo e relacionadas ao setor imobiliário, como Lennar, Lowe's e McDonald's, têm sido negociadas perto de suas mínimas de 52 semanas, e os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro têm subido.

segments.src: This pattern is often called **narrow market breadth**.
segments.tr: Esse padrão é frequentemente chamado de **amplitude de mercado restrita**.

segments.src: This article explains what it means, why it matters for ordinary savers, and what to watch as earnings season begins.
segments.tr: Este artigo explica o que isso significa, por que é importante para os poupadores comuns e o que observar à medida que a temporada de balanços começa.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *Este artigo é apenas para fins informativos gerais.
